name: Issachar
summary: Jacob's fifth son by Leah, born after she traded her son's mandrakes for a night with Jacob. Jacob said Issachar was a strong donkey who would bow his shoulder to bear burdens.

key_moments.title: Born After the Mandrakes
key_moments.description: Rachel wanted Reuben's mandrakes, so Leah traded them for a night with Jacob. God listened to Leah and she bore a son, and she named him Issachar, saying God had given her her hire.

key_moments.title: Goes Down to Egypt
key_moments.description: Issachar went down to Egypt with his father Jacob and the whole family, along with his sons.

key_moments.title: Blessed by Jacob
key_moments.description: Jacob said Issachar was a strong donkey lying down between two burdens. He saw that rest was good and the land pleasant, and bowed his shoulder to bear and became a servant to tribute.
